def intake(client, form):
    prompt = f"Applicant {form.name}, SSN {form.ssn}, income {form.income}: {form.question}"
    log.debug("intake prompt %s", prompt)
    scrubbed = scrub_pii(prompt)
    return client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=300, messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": INTAKE_PROMPT},
        {"role": "user", "content": scrubbed},
    ]).choices[0].message.content

def search(tenant_id, query, lang="en"):
    coll = chroma.get_collection("shared_kb")
    res = coll.query(query_texts=[query], n_results=5, where={"language": lang})
    return res["documents"][0]

def related_docs(cur, account, qvec):
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, content FROM doc_chunks WHERE is_published = true "
        "ORDER BY embedding <=> %s::vector LIMIT 6",
        (qvec,),
    )
    return [{"id": r[0], "text": r[1]} for r in cur.fetchall()]

@app.post("/team/docs")
async def add_team_doc(file: UploadFile, member=Depends(require_team_member)):
    raw = await file.read()
    nodes = SentenceSplitter(chunk_size=512).get_nodes_from_documents(
        [Document(text=raw.decode("utf-8", "ignore"))])
    team_index(member.team_id).insert_nodes(nodes)
    return {"nodes": len(nodes)}

def build_site_index(start_urls, tenant_ns):
    docs = []
    for url in start_urls:
        docs += SimpleWebPageReader(html_to_text=True).load_data([url])
    pipeline = IngestionPipeline(transformations=[SentenceSplitter(chunk_size=600), embed_model],
                                 vector_store=qdrant_store(tenant_ns))
    pipeline.run(documents=docs)
